description: This file demonstrates model ensembling and vectorization using functorch's vmap, including defining a simple CNN model, generating dummy data, and applying vmap to ensemble predictions.

classes.name: SimpleCNN
classes.description: A simple convolutional neural network model for image classification.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Defines the forward pass of the SimpleCNN model, applying convolutional layers, ReLU activations, max pooling, flattening, and fully connected layers, ending with log softmax.
